text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Flamewars raged online, and a storm of 
slander hit the Academy. Some might say no 
obstacle is harder to overcome than public 
scrutiny. But—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer tore down that "barrier." 
Standing alone at a press conference, they 
boldly declared it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Together, they will take on the Yasuda 
Kinen and the Takarazuka Kinen! To become 
the one who supports Tanino Gimlet 
completely! To that end, they vowed to 
"stake this entire life!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The world must've realized it by now. 
There really are folks out there who'd 
stick their whole neck into the Mouth of 
Truth instead of just a hand!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was enraptured by that resolve. 
Next—it's my turn to pour the celebratory 
toast for the Yasuda Kinen.
